paragraphs.en: The reason your React component is re-rendering is likely because you're creating a new object reference on each render cycle. When you pass an inline object as a prop, React's shallow comparison sees it as a different object every time, which triggers a re-render. I'd recommend using useMemo to memoize the object.
paragraphs.zh: 你的 React 组件重新渲染的原因很可能是你在每次渲染周期中都创建了一个新的对象引用。 当你把一个内联对象作为 prop 传递时，React 的浅比较每次都会把它视为不同的对象，从而触发重新渲染。 我建议使用 useMemo 来记忆化该对象。

sents.en: The reason your React component is re-rendering is likely because you're creating a new object reference on each render cycle.
sents.zh: 你的 React 组件重新渲染的原因很可能是你在每次渲染周期中都创建了一个新的对象引用。

sents.en: When you pass an inline object as a prop, React's shallow comparison sees it as a different object every time, which triggers a re-render.

sents.en: I'd recommend using useMemo to memoize the object.
sents.zh: 我建议使用 useMemo 来记忆化该对象。

paragraphs.en: New object ref each render, so React re-renders. Wrap the prop in useMemo .
paragraphs.zh: 每次渲染都会产生新的对象引用，因此 React 会重新渲染。 用 useMemo 包裹该属性（prop）。

paragraphs.en: Two findings shaped caveman. Adobe: cavemanning your prompt makes answers worse, so caveman never touches your prompt. JetBrains: agent sessions are mostly code and tool calls, which the voice leaves alone. So caveman grew rocks that shrink what the agent reads and what it runs on .
paragraphs.zh: 两个发现塑造了 caveman。 Adobe：把你的提示词变成「原始人风格」会让答案变差，所以 caveman 绝不改动你的提示词。 JetBrains：智能体会话主要是代码和工具调用，而语音部分不会碰这些内容。 因此 caveman 发展出了「石块」，用来缩减智能体读取的内容以及它运行时依赖的内容。

paragraphs.en: "Be concise" is the real baseline; new models already know it. On top of it, /caveman cuts 3% more at the median and /ultracave 35% more. Measured on the 3.1.0 rules, not yet re-run. The rules cost about 1,160 tokens of input, and if you pay per request (GitHub Copilot), shorter answers save nothing. Harness · Every case where caveman loses
paragraphs.zh: 「简洁表达」才是真正的基线；新模型本来就知道这一点。 在此基础上，/caveman 在中位数上再减少 3%，/ultracave 再减少 35%。 基于 3.1.0 版规则测得，尚未重新运行。 这些规则消耗约 1,160 个输入 token，而如果你按请求付费（GitHub Copilot），更短的回答并不能省钱。 运行环境 · caveman 落败的所有案例

paragraphs.en: The file is each test file through today's compressor alone. The session is the whole agent run, which also carries the system prompt and tools, so it moves less. Honest part: the session run is from August 2026 on an older engine, HTML has no compressor yet so it lost, and each test file hides one record in 61 to 72 KB of noise. Yours will vary. Headroom on the same suite: 15 of 18 right, 6.7% fewer tokens. Method
paragraphs.zh: 文件是指每个测试文件仅通过今天的压缩器处理的结果。 会话是指整个智能体运行，其中还包含系统提示词和工具，因此移动的内容更少。 诚实说明：会话运行是在 2026 年 8 月用一个较旧的引擎完成的，HTML 尚无压缩器所以落败，并且每个测试文件在 61 到 72 KB 的噪声中隐藏了一条记录。你的结果会有所不同。 在同一测试集上的提升空间：18 题对 15 题，减少 6.7% 的 token。方法

paragraphs.en: Auto costs 0.46× what Opus 5.5 at xhigh costs. That is 54% saved, in under half the time. 85 real coding tasks from SWE-Interact and SWE-Together, one try each. paragraphs.en: skills.sh for code mode. Code mode is the agent writing a script instead of making tool call after tool call ( Cloudflare , Anthropic ). Problem: agent write same script every session, throw it away, write it again. Blocks keep it in your repo, check it every pull request, hand it back.
